answers.core: Multidimensional arrays are used frequently enough to warrant being a part of core. Also, come to think of it, I'm not sure GDScript actually has support for CSV indexers.
answers.workaround: Multidimensional arrays are a frequent occurrence, and while manual indexing of a 1D array can be done via fairly trivial multiplication, it can quickly make things cluttered, especially when you want to index based on an expression rather than a single value.
